Definition: from G2316 and the base of G4767; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater of God.
BiblicalUsage: The word theostygḗs carries the sense of hateful to God. In Romans 1:30, haters of God, despiteful.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hateful to God still tells the truth about God, and I take it as it stands.
